summary: Electra Battery Materials Corp filed a Form 6-K on June 23, 2026, reporting the voting results from its 2026 annual general and special meeting. The filing discloses that 46.47% of outstanding common shares were represented. Shareholders voted to elect seven director nominees, with each receiving over 98% support, and approved an amendment to the long-term incentive plan to increase the number of issuable awards. This is a routine shareholder meeting outcome, not a special situation. No event triggering a special-situation classification is present.
